camel_example: aliyun iot QueryDeviceStatistics --region cn-hangzhou --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --ProductKey a1BwAGV0000 --GroupId W16X8Tvdosec0000
description_en: Queries device statistics, including the number of online devices, activated devices, and total created devices
description_zh: 调用该接口查询设备统计数据，包括在线设备数、已激活设备数和已创建的设备总数
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-device-statistics --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --group-id W16X8Tvdosec0000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryDeviceStatistics

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no<props="intl"><ph> Overview page or</ph></props> ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the devices belong.
If you specify this parameter, the device statistics of the specified product are returned. If you also specify GroupId, the device statistics of the specified product in the specified group are returned.
If you do not specify this parameter or GroupId, the device statistics of all devices under the current account are returned
parameters.help_zh:
要查询设备所属的产品ProductKey。
传入此参数，返回该产品下的设备统计数据。如果同时传入GroupId，返回指定分组下该产品的设备统计数据。
不传入此参数和GroupId，则返回当前账号下所有设备统计数据
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the group to which the devices belong.

If you specify this parameter, the device statistics of the specified group are returned. If you also specify ProductKey, the device statistics of the specified product in the specified group are returned.
If you do not specify this parameter or ProductKey, the device statistics of all devices under the current account are returned
parameters.help_zh:
要查询设备所属的分组ID。

传入此参数，返回该分组下的设备统计数据。如果同时传入ProductKey，返回该分组下指定产品的设备统计数据。
不传入此参数和ProductKey，返回当前账号下所有设备统计数据
parameters.name: group_id
